<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option('woocommerce_store_address','Test');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country','ES');
update_option('woocommerce_currency','EUR');
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon','no');
WC_Install::create_pages();
$product = new WC_Product_Variable();
$product->set_name('Dripper de prueba');
$product->set_slug('dripper-prueba');
$product->set_status('publish');
$product->set_featured(true);
$product->set_description('Producto de prueba local.');
$attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
$attribute->set_name('Color');
$attribute->set_options(array('Negro','Rojo','Azul','Verde','Rosa','Violeta'));
$attribute->set_visible(true); $attribute->set_variation(true);
$product->set_attributes(array($attribute));
$product->save();
foreach(array('Negro'=>'#000000','Rojo'=>'#982626','Azul'=>'#1d3153','Verde'=>'#244130','Rosa'=>'#791442','Violeta'=>'#452463') as $name=>$hex){
$v=new WC_Product_Variation(); $v->set_parent_id($product->get_id()); $v->set_attributes(array('color'=>$name)); $v->set_regular_price('6.50'); $v->set_status('publish'); $v->update_meta_data('_spray_nova_color_hex',$hex); $v->save();
}
WC_Product_Variable::sync($product->get_id());
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules();
